text: It is raining cats and dogs.
fr: Il pleut des cordes. En anglais on parle de chats et de chiens, pas de cordes !
en: It is raining very heavily.
example: Take an umbrella: it is raining cats and dogs outside.

text: A joke can help to break the ice.
fr: Une blague peut aider à briser la glace : détendre l'ambiance quand on ne se connaît pas encore.
en: To make people feel relaxed when they meet for the first time.
example: She asked about my hobbies to break the ice.

text: The exam was a piece of cake.
fr: L'examen était un jeu d'enfant. « A piece of cake » veut dire très facile.
en: Something is very easy.
example: I studied a lot, so the test was a piece of cake.

text: I need to hit the books this weekend.
fr: Je dois m'y mettre sérieusement et réviser. « Hit the books » veut dire étudier avec application.
en: To study hard.
example: The exam is on Monday, so I need to hit the books this weekend.

text: Let us get the ball rolling.
fr: Lançons les choses, commençons ! On dit cela au début d'une réunion ou d'un projet.
en: To start something.
example: Let us get the ball rolling with the first question.

text: I think we are on the same page.
fr: Je pense que nous sommes sur la même longueur d'onde : nous comprenons la situation de la même façon.
en: We understand the situation in the same way.
example: After the meeting, we were all on the same page.

text: Losing that job was a blessing in disguise.
fr: Perdre ce travail a été un mal pour un bien : une mauvaise nouvelle qui s'est révélée positive.
en: Something that looks bad but turns out good.
example: Missing the bus was a blessing in disguise: I met my best friend.

text: You hit the nail on the head.
fr: Tu as mis le doigt dessus : tu as dit exactement ce qu'il fallait.
en: You said exactly the right thing.
example: That is the problem: you hit the nail on the head.

text: It is late, so let us call it a day.
fr: Il est tard, arrêtons-nous là pour aujourd'hui.
en: To stop working for today.
example: We worked for six hours, then we called it a day.

text: Do not worry, it is not rocket science.
fr: Ne t'inquiète pas, ce n'est pas sorcier : en anglais, on compare aux fusées.
en: It is not difficult.
example: The new app is easy to use: it is not rocket science.

text: I burn the midnight oil before every exam.
fr: Je travaille tard dans la nuit avant chaque examen. « Burn the midnight oil » veut dire veiller pour travailler.
en: To work until late at night.
example: She burned the midnight oil to finish her project.

text: Please do not spill the beans about the surprise.
fr: S'il te plaît, ne vends pas la mèche pour la surprise : ne révèle pas le secret.
en: To tell a secret by mistake.
example: He spilled the beans about the party.

text: I am feeling under the weather today.
fr: Je ne suis pas dans mon assiette aujourd'hui : un peu malade ou fatigué.
en: A little sick or tired.
example: I stayed at home because I was under the weather.

text: Time flies when you are having fun.
fr: Le temps passe vite quand on s'amuse : « fly » veut dire voler.
en: Time seems to pass quickly when you enjoy yourself.
example: The trip was great and time flew by.

text: Actions speak louder than words.
fr: Les actes valent mieux que les paroles : ce qu'on fait compte plus que ce qu'on dit.
en: What you do is more important than what you say.
example: He promised a lot, but actions speak louder than words.

text: I will keep my fingers crossed for you.
fr: Je croise les doigts pour toi : je te souhaite bonne chance.
en: To hope that someone will be lucky.
example: Good luck tomorrow, I will keep my fingers crossed.

text: I am a night owl, I study late.
fr: Je suis un oiseau de nuit, je travaille tard : un couche-tard, en français.
en: A person who prefers to stay up late.
example: My brother is a night owl, he sleeps until noon.

text: Speak of the devil, here he comes.
fr: Quand on parle du loup, on en voit la queue : la personne dont on parlait arrive.
en: The person we were talking about just arrived.
example: We were talking about Sam. Speak of the devil!

text: The early bird catches the worm.
fr: L'avenir appartient à ceux qui se lèvent tôt : celui qui agit tôt a plus de chances de réussir.
en: People who start early get the best result.
example: Go to the bank at eight: the early bird catches the worm.

text: Do not put all your eggs in one basket.
fr: Ne mets pas tous tes œufs dans le même panier : ne mise pas tout sur une seule chose.
en: Do not risk everything on one choice.
example: Apply to several universities. Do not put all your eggs in one basket.

text: Break a leg at your interview tomorrow.
fr: Bonne chance pour ton entretien ! On dit « break a leg » pour souhaiter bonne chance, surtout au théâtre.
en: Good luck.
example: You have your interview tomorrow? Break a leg!

text: Tell me more, I am all ears.
fr: Dis-m'en plus, je suis tout ouïe : j'écoute avec toute mon attention.
en: I am listening carefully.
example: What happened at the embassy? I am all ears.

text: The news came out of the blue.
fr: La nouvelle est tombée de nulle part, sans prévenir : une surprise complète.
en: Suddenly and without warning.
example: She called me out of the blue after five years.

text: Do not worry, we are all in the same boat.
fr: Ne t'inquiète pas, nous sommes tous dans le même bateau : dans la même situation difficile.
en: We are all in the same difficult situation.
example: Everyone is nervous before the exam: we are all in the same boat.

text: We need to think outside the box.
fr: Il faut sortir des sentiers battus : penser de façon originale, créative.
en: To think in a new and creative way.
example: The usual solution does not work, so think outside the box.

text: The plan failed, so we are back to square one.
fr: Le plan a échoué, nous revenons à la case départ.
en: At the beginning again.
example: I lost my file, so I am back to square one.

text: Do not cut corners on your homework.
fr: Ne bâcle pas tes devoirs : « cut corners » veut dire faire le travail vite et mal pour gagner du temps.
en: To do something badly to save time or money.
example: The builder cut corners and the wall fell.

text: I had to bite the bullet and ask for help.
fr: J'ai dû serrer les dents et demander de l'aide : accepter de faire quelque chose de désagréable.
en: To do something unpleasant because you must.
example: I bit the bullet and told him the truth.

text: I sent my application, now the ball is in their court.
fr: J'ai envoyé ma candidature, maintenant la balle est dans leur camp : c'est à eux de décider.
en: It is the other person's turn to decide.
example: I did my part. Now the ball is in your court.

text: Everyone jumped on the bandwagon.
fr: Tout le monde a suivi le mouvement : on fait comme les autres parce que c'est à la mode.
en: To join something because it is popular.
example: When the app became famous, every company jumped on the bandwagon.

text: To make a long story short, I got the job.
fr: Pour faire court, j'ai eu le travail : on résume une histoire longue.
en: To tell only the main points.
example: To make a long story short, we missed the flight.

text: I learned the answer by heart.
fr: J'ai appris la réponse par cœur : en anglais aussi, on apprend « by heart ».
en: To learn something so well that you can say it without notes.
example: She knows the whole song by heart.

text: It is a long shot, but I will try.
fr: C'est très peu probable, mais je vais essayer : une petite chance de réussir.
en: Something with a small chance of success.
example: Getting that scholarship is a long shot, but I will apply.

text: Let us kill two birds with one stone.
fr: Faisons d'une pierre deux coups : régler deux choses avec une seule action.
en: To solve two problems with one action.
example: I will practice English and meet friends: two birds with one stone.

text: Every cloud has a silver lining.
fr: À quelque chose malheur est bon : même une mauvaise situation a un bon côté.
en: There is something good even in a bad situation.
example: I failed, but I learned a lot: every cloud has a silver lining.

text: That is easier said than done.
fr: C'est plus facile à dire qu'à faire.
en: It sounds simple, but it is hard to do.
example: Speak without fear? That is easier said than done.

text: She always goes the extra mile for her students.
fr: Elle fait toujours un effort supplémentaire pour ses étudiants : elle en fait plus que ce qu'on lui demande.
en: To do more than is expected.
example: He went the extra mile and stayed to help me.

text: I think you are barking up the wrong tree.
fr: Je pense que tu te trompes de piste : tu cherches au mauvais endroit, ou tu accuses la mauvaise personne.
en: To look for something in the wrong place.
example: If you ask me about maths, you are barking up the wrong tree.

text: Look on the bright side, you passed.
fr: Vois le bon côté des choses : tu as réussi.
en: Think about the good part of a bad situation.
example: The flight is late, but look on the bright side: we can have lunch.

text: It is time to hit the road.
fr: Il est temps de prendre la route : de partir.
en: To start a journey, to leave.
example: We are late, so let us hit the road.

text: We meet once in a blue moon.
fr: On se voit très rarement. « Once in a blue moon » veut dire presque jamais.
en: Very rarely.
example: I eat fast food once in a blue moon.

text: This phone costs an arm and a leg.
fr: Ce téléphone coûte les yeux de la tête : en anglais, on donne un bras et une jambe.
en: Very expensive.
example: Studying abroad can cost an arm and a leg.

text: Hang in there, it will get better.
fr: Tiens bon, ça va aller mieux : on encourage quelqu'un dans une période difficile.
en: Do not give up.
example: The first month is hard, but hang in there.

text: Step out of your comfort zone.
fr: Sors de ta zone de confort : essaie même si tu as peur de te tromper.
en: Try something new even if it feels hard.
example: To improve your English, you must step out of your comfort zone.

text: Better late than never.
fr: Mieux vaut tard que jamais.
en: It is good to do something late, not to skip it.
example: You finally started to practice? Better late than never.
